name: Patrol Visor
description: UNIT 0900 · Patrol Visor. An armoured patrol helmet; the time burns in the visor. A scan beam sweeps it every 6 s, a reticle hunts and locks on the time once a minute, the minute digits recalibrate at each new minute, and the status light pulses. Engraved date, heart rate, steps (with a bar), battery (with cells). Dim visor clock in always-on mode.
